correctness.rationale: Verified definitions and quantifiers n>=5, arbitrary Latin-square table; all maximal faces partition into 3n lines, independent intercalate tetrahedra and mixed triangles. For each line, descending-size nonanchor-to-anchor elementary collapses have provably free lower face; remaining tetrahedra collapse on unique mixed triangles. Exact remaining 2-complex f-vector gives Euler rank. A symbol edge becomes a rook path across a filled triangle; every rook square is filled by a 2- or 6-triangle combinatorial disk with verified edge links; Delta^(n-1) x Delta^(n-1) 2-skeleton therefore supplies pi_1=0. H2 is free as subgroup C2 and Whitehead yields the claimed wedge. Actual standalone checks of all collapse pairs and squares for n5 cyclic, n6 cyclic and nonabelian, n8 Boolean passed; finite checks corroborate but do not replace proof.
